environment.renderer: OGRE2 with --headless-rendering (no X server for the server process; software GL in the container)

clock.measured_rate_note: bag-info: 44568 /clock messages over 44.577 s of simulation time = 999.8 Hz

time_base.stamp_source: simulation time (/clock, use_sim_time=true) for every sensor, odometry and tf message
time_base.note: Gazebo runs slower than real time on the software renderer; ros2 topic hz without --wall-time uses the header stamps and therefore reports simulation-time rates, while --wall-time reports host-time rates.

sensors.name: camera
sensors.declared_rate_note: SDF update_rate. The course kit ships 20 Hz; PR07 changed exactly this one sensor parameter to 10 Hz to reduce render load.
sensors.measured_note: Renderer-bound. Every camera frame is rendered by OGRE2 in software; the sensor cannot reach its 10 Hz update_rate, the observed gap between frames is 0.1-0.8 s of simulation time. 199 frames over 44.577 s in the bag = 4.46 Hz.

sensors.name: lidar
sensors.measured_note: Matches update_rate in simulation time: 242 samples in 24.1 s of simulation and 446 samples in 44.577 s in the bag. Wall rate is 10 x RTF.

sensors.name: imu
sensors.measured_note: Matches update_rate exactly in simulation time (2413 messages in 24.12 s, 4453 in 44.577 s). After the defect was fixed the IMU is again bridged GZ->ROS (defect-after.txt).

odometry.measured_note: AckermannSteering odom_publish_frequency=50; 1207 messages in 24.12 s and 2227 in 44.577 s. The adapter preserves the message rate, it does not resample.

tf.stamp: identical to the /vehicle/odom header stamp of the same message
tf.bag_note: bag-info: 2228 /tf messages vs 2227 /vehicle/odom messages, so the adapter wrote exactly one transform per odometry sample

static_tf_owner.bag_note: one transient-local /tf_static message is present in the bag

frames.note: Static offsets come from the PR06 URDF, which is the frame contract of the project. The course SDF places the sensors at its own offsets (0.28, 0, 0.38); PR07 verifies frame connectivity and ownership, not the metric agreement between the URDF and the SDF.

measurement.primary: evidence/pr07/measurements.json (30 s wall window; simulation and wall rate per topic, RTF=0.804)
measurement.cross_check: evidence/pr07/rates.txt (ros2 topic hz, simulation time and --wall-time, earlier window)
measurement.bag: evidence/pr07/bag-info.txt (required recording: 44.577 s, seven topics, 138.6 MiB MCAP)
